metadata.title: What Is the Most Environmentally Friendly Way to Do Laundry? | Tide
metadata.description: Learn the most environmentally friendly way to do laundry using science-based lifecycle principles. Discover how cold-water washing, effective first-time cleaning, concentrated detergents, proper dosing, and fabric-friendly wash cycles can help reduce the environmental impact of every load.
